title: The Frog Crew
description: This Modpack is intended for CaptainMariVT's Minecraft Server. For her and her Viewers.
body:
This is a mod pack created for CaptainMariVT and her community.
It's a cozy, chill vibes focused mod pack. The mods in here are mainly Farming, Building and Ribbits with an addition of Create as well as a few QOL mods.
